name: The Morning Rush
description: Regulars at the corner café each ordered a different drink and a different pastry one busy morning. Work out who had what.
clues: The Chai order's price is between the order with Vanilla syrup and Ava.
Edith, Caramel, and Maple go with Chai, Macchiato, and Ristretto, in some order.
Caramel goes with exactly two of Felix, Ristretto, and $16.
